# Modern Spring Boot Best Practices Plugin ### Spring Boot 3.x+ Microservice Architecture, RestClient & ProblemDetail [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Modern Spring Boot 3.x+ microservice conventions and best practices: strict constructor injection, immutable configuration records, placeholder discipline without default fallback values (.env.example discipline), RFC 7807 ProblemDetail error handling, fluent RestClient & JdbcClient APIs, Testcontainers @ServiceConnection, and cloud-native Micrometer observability.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-spring-boot-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-spring-boot-best-practices ``` --- ## Overview Modern Spring Boot 3.x+ application development demands lean framework coupling, strong immutability, deterministic configuration management, and native-first Java 21 integration. This plugin enforces production-grade conventions across seven fundamental pillars: 1. **Dependency Injection**: Constructor injection exclusively; absolute ban on field injection (`@Autowired`). 2. **Configuration & Placeholders**: Record-based `@ConfigurationProperties`, ban on `@Value`, and strict placeholder discipline without default fallback values (driven by `.env.example`). 3. **Web & REST APIs**: Fluent `RestClient` over legacy `RestTemplate`, and RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` error handling with `@RestControllerAdvice`. 4. **Data Access**: Fluent `JdbcClient` over legacy `JdbcTemplate`, transaction boundary discipline, and `ListCrudRepository`. 5. **Concurrency & Performance**: Native Java 21 Virtual Threads (`spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true`) and GraalVM AOT readiness. 6. **Testing**: Fast slice testing (`@WebMvcTest`, `@DataJpaTest`), Testcontainers with `@ServiceConnection`, and `@MockitoBean`. 7. **Observability**: Micrometer Observation registry, structured distributed tracing, and Actuator endpoints. --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-spring-boot-conventions.md`](rules/modern-spring-boot-conventions.md)**: Automatically enforces modern Spring Boot 3.x+ microservice conventions: strict constructor injection, record-based ConfigurationProperties, strict placeholder discipline without default fallback values (.env.example discipline), RFC 7807 ProblemDetail, RestClient, JdbcClient, and Testcontainers @ServiceConnection. ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-spring-boot-conventions`](skills/modern-spring-boot-conventions/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when developing, refactoring, or reviewing Spring Boot 3.x+ applications. Covers Spring-specific best practices, including configuration, DI, REST controllers, data access, Observability, and modern APIs (RestClient, JdbcClient). --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-spring-boot-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-spring-boot-conventions.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-spring-boot-conventions/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown - "Refactor Spring Boot service to strict constructor injection and RestClient" - "Implement RFC 7807 ProblemDetail error handling and record ConfigurationProperties" - "Set up integration testing with Testcontainers and @ServiceConnection" ``` --- ## 📄 License & Corporate Governance Distributed under the **MIT License**.
